gdscript.defer_reason: godot LSP binary/env varies per project; grammar alone insufficient

glsl.defer_reason: no stable LSP binary; GLSL is often injected into shader strings

sh.defer_reason: shell script grammar is the builtin bash entry; no dedicated LSP

swift.defer_reason: tree-sitter-swift is codegen-only: the repo ships grammar.js + scanner.c but no src/parser.c, so a bare checkout cannot compile; requires a codegen step
